_readme: Custom-sort eval set for scripts/eval-sort.ts. 286 element names (cat 'junk' = legacy junk names). rank: high = clear members, low = clear non-members, tiers = chains ordered low -> high; pair_with = positive twin of a negation, components = parts of a compound. groups: expected = strict label (a group or 'Other'), accept = soft labels (any listed bucket is correct). split 'tune' may be looked at while changing prompts; 'holdout' is for confirming a change once. informational cases were labeled after seeing results; never gate on them.

rank.prompt: would fit in a Pokémon game
things not found in a kitchen
